game_description: Competitive real-time 60-second timed vocabulary typing arena with Support Core tactical abilities.

match_loop.race_mode_round_4: Colyseus v0.17+ 1v1 Race Mode enabled in multiplayer matches.

support_core_families.name: Combo Core
support_core_families.mechanics: Multiplies score output based on consecutive correct answer streaks. Ideal for high-accuracy players with over 80% accuracy.
support_core_families.best_for: Players with high accuracy who can maintain 10+ word typing streaks.

support_core_families.name: Speedster Core
support_core_families.mechanics: Awards up to +200 speed bonus points for fast answers under 2.5 seconds. Features cyan timer glow and wind speed overlay.
support_core_families.best_for: Fast typists (>80 WPM) who answer words rapidly in under 2 seconds.

support_core_families.name: Oracle Core
support_core_families.mechanics: Reveals letter slot hints progressively for tough vocabulary words. Eliminates guesswork on complex terms.
support_core_families.best_for: Players facing difficult or unfamiliar vocabulary categories.

support_core_families.name: Aegis Core
support_core_families.mechanics: Grants protective shield stacks that absorb spelling mistakes without deducting total match points.
support_core_families.best_for: Defensive playstyles or players aiming to preserve point momentum.

support_core_families.name: Mission Core
support_core_families.mechanics: Issues in-match mini bounties (e.g. 5 consecutive correct answers) for massive milestone bonus payouts.
support_core_families.best_for: Strategic players focused on completing high-value milestone targets.

support_core_families.name: Phoenix Core
support_core_families.mechanics: Grants rebirth and comeback bonuses when player score drops or recovery is needed after errors.
support_core_families.best_for: Players seeking high resilience and comeback potential.

support_core_families.name: Pandora Core
support_core_families.mechanics: Shapeshifts randomly into another Support Core during match rounds with unpredictable multiplier gambles.
support_core_families.best_for: Versatile typists who enjoy dynamic, chaotic game mechanics.

support_core_families.name: High Roller Core
support_core_families.mechanics: High-risk gambling score multipliers. Correct answers yield massive payouts; errors apply heavier penalties.
support_core_families.best_for: Risk-takers confident in scoring 1,000+ points per round.

support_core_families.name: Power Core
support_core_families.mechanics: Provides raw score output, hypercharge multipliers, and explosive point surges per word.

support_core_families.name: Balanced Core
support_core_families.mechanics: Provides steady equilibrium score scaling with high error tolerance and consistent performance.
support_core_families.best_for: Beginners or players seeking stable, risk-free point growth.

scoring_formulas.levenshtein_penalty: High accuracy (≥80%): penalty = distance × 2. Low accuracy (<80% or Skip): penalty = clamp(distance × 10, 10 to 50 pts).
